subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and a cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention contract, or should this stay as narrower memory-plugin and channel-plugin work?
rationale: The requested behavior changes memory authority, durable storage shape, prompt precedence, conflict handling, and channel reply policy; code inspection shows current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for this layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Narrowly
options.body: Handle Feishu self-mention loss and group target attribution in focused channel issues while opening a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that product direction.

options.title: Route To Plugin/API Design
options.body: Require durable rule learning to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent cross-surface history across Feishu runtime, memory docs, prompt/runtime boundaries, and broad source-grounded repository changes.
